info.title: Local Cast Recorder Control API
info.description: Control the native Cast listener and copy completed recordings. Read the bearer token from .runtime/api.token on the host and provide it via Authorization: Bearer <token>. Start and stop are asynchronous: poll GET /v1/listener about once per second. Starting is complete when state is listening. Stopping is complete when state is stopped; MP4 conversion can take longer than real time. A failed state or non-null error needs attention. Stopping the listener leaves this API running. Only completed MP4s are listed/downloadable; downloads copy bytes to the client without deleting the original. No request bodies are required.

servers.description: Same host and port as this OpenAPI document

get.summary: Get this OpenAPI document without authentication

post.description: Optional JSON filename selects an MP4 basename under recordings; omission keeps random names. Existing filenames/session directories return 409. Subsequent Cast sessions use numbered suffixes, skipping existing names. Idempotent while starting or listening when filename is omitted or matches the current choice. A different filename returns 409; stop the listener before choosing a new filename. Returns 409 during shutdown. Acceptance does not guarantee startup success: poll status for listening or failed. Does not initiate a Chrome cast or start recording without a sender.

post.summary: Stop listening and finalize the current recording
post.description: Idempotent when already stopped or stopping. Poll status until stopped before restarting. Do not force-kill the receiver during finalization.

get.description: Excludes active recordings and incomplete/failed conversions. Results are sorted by filename. No pagination.

delete.summary: Permanently delete a completed MP4 from the host
delete.description: Only completed recordings can be deleted. Active recordings, incomplete/failed conversions and symbolic links are excluded. Repeating a successful deletion returns 404.

404.description: Recording missing, invalid, or not completed

409.description: Recording could not be deleted due to a filesystem error

get.summary: Copy a completed MP4 to the client
get.description: Stream the full response to a destination file. The source remains on the host. Range requests and partial/resumable downloads are not supported.

404.description: Recording missing, invalid, or not completed

bearerAuth.description: Opaque token from the host's .runtime/api.token file; not a JWT.

Accepted.description: Request accepted; poll status for completion

Conflict.description: Listener is still stopping or a lifecycle operation could not be performed

bytes.description: Intermediate MKV size on disk; may lag buffered packets. Not final MP4 size or recording duration.

error.description: Last observed error; cleared on a new start.

modifiedAt.description: File modification time in ISO 8601 UTC format.

downloadUrl.description: Path relative to the API origin; requires the same bearer token.
